topic_title: Establishing a Safe Following Interval (3-Sec Rule)
prompt: Why must you increase following distance to four to six seconds when following a motorcycle?

options.text: Motorcycle exhaust pipes emit heavy combustible gasses that ignite car radiators
Motorcycles can stop much faster than cars, and minor contact is fatal to rider
Texas law requires passenger cars to yield right-of-way to all two-wheeled units
Motorcycle riders possess statutory rights to occupy two full adjacent lanes
